metadata.title: सरकार अपना वाद भूल गई - बंधु तिर्की | Why CNT Act is need changes | Main bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
In this special ground report from Ranchi, Main Bhi Bharat editor Shyam Sunder speaks to senior Congress leader and former minister Bandhu Tirkey at the Tribal Research Institute. On the occasion of 117 years of the Chhotanagpur Tenancy (CNT) Act, Tirkey reflects on the relevance of this landmark law that protects Adivasi land rights in Jharkhand.
From the historical importance of the CNT Act to today’s challenges—land grab, demographic changes, industrial development, land banks, and the long-pending PESA rules—this conversation dives deep into the questions that shape Jharkhand’s Adivasi identity and rights.
Bandhu Tirkey addresses tough questions on political accountability, development vs. displacement, the role of governments, and the urgent need for open dialogue to safeguard tribal land and culture.
👉 Watch the full interview for an honest and insightful discussion on Adivasi rights, governance, and the future of Jharkhand.
